id: ISS-0950
title: "Catalog service endpoint_url is not URL-validated at registration/publish time (decision 0027 gap)"
discovered_by: SECURITY-REVIEWER
discovered_in_run: WF03-ISS0917-20261001 (filed by ORCH)
discovered_at: "2026-10-01T14:06:29Z"
severity: MINOR
owner: "ELIXIR-DEV"
description: >
  Found by SECURITY-REVIEWER in WF03-ISS0917-20261001. POST /service-catalog and publish do no
  UrlValidator check on endpoint_url; the only control is the dispatch-time INV-9 gate in
  ServiceTaskDispatcher.http_transport/3. ISS-0917's fix makes catalog endpoints reachable by the
  dispatcher for the first time, so add fast-feedback syntactic validation (https scheme, host not
  private/loopback literal) at register/publish time in Letflow.ServiceCatalog /
  Routers.AdminServices. Defense in depth; dispatch gate stays binding. Severity MINOR (hardening).
  Owner ELIXIR-DEV (via CODE-DESIGNER).
affected_files:
  - lib/letflow/service_catalog.ex
  - lib/letflow/routers/admin_services.ex
queue_ref: Q-921  # queue issue_ref ISS-0921 collides with an existing local file; local filename ISS-0950
github_ref: GH-2095
status: open

task.description: WF-03 Step 3 IMPLEMENT. Implement exactly the validated design lib/letflow/design/iss0950-catalog-endpoint-url-register-validation.md (gate passed: step-02b-r2). Work in the main checkout C:/Users/tvolo/dev/ai-dala/letflow-3 on branch feature/WF03-ISS0950-20261001 (already created/pushed; do not switch branches). Scope: UrlValidator.validate_syntactic/1 (no DNS, shares the existing blocklist, validate/1,2 and the dispatcher gate UNCHANGED), the changeset validation in Entry insert/publish changesets (per design D-sections incl. get_field semantics and template policy), the two @doc sentences in service_catalog.ex per design section 4, and the single existing-fixture adjustment in test/letflow/engine_catalog_service_task_test.exs (~363) per design. Do NOT write the new regression test matrix -- TEST-DESIGNER does that next (fail-first discipline); but do verify by hand/scratch (outside the repo or deleted afterwards) that the key rejections work. Run ONLY scoped tests: MIX_ENV=test mix test test/letflow/engine_catalog_service_task_test.exs test/letflow/service_catalog_test.exs and the existing url_validator and admin_services/service-catalog route test files (find them with Glob); quote the real output. mix compile --warnings-as-errors must pass; run mix format on touched files. Machine is shared: NO full suite. Do not touch Q-866/REQ-429, Q-914/915, Q-908, Q-916, PR #2093/#2094 files. Do not commit (ORCH commits). Complete the handoff PASS/FAIL per HANDOFF_PROTOCOL.md with the list of changed files.
acceptance_criteria: validate_syntactic/1 added with @spec; no DNS path; blocklist reused not duplicated
Entry insert and publish changesets reject non-https, private/loopback/link-local IP literals, templated host, with the design's error shape; accept the design's accepted classes
validate/1,2 and ServiceTaskDispatcher.http_transport gate unchanged (git diff shows no change to them)
mix compile --warnings-as-errors clean and scoped existing tests green (real output quoted)

result.summary: Implemented design iss0950 exactly. url_validator.ex: added public validate_syntactic/1 (@spec; shares check_scheme/check_ip_literal/blocklist via a :no_dns mode on check_host; validate/1,2 and default_resolver untouched; moduledoc paragraph). entry.ex: alias UrlValidator, public check_endpoint_url/1 (head extraction at first / ? # after first ://, brace in head rejected, validate_syntactic on head only), private validate_endpoint_url/1 using get_field (runs on unchanged values; skipped for nil or existing :endpoint_url error), wired after validate_length in insert_changeset and publish_changeset, error message and validation: :endpoint_url_not_allowed per D4, moduledoc paragraph. service_catalog.ex: two @doc sentences only (register/1, publish/3). engine_catalog_service_task_test.exs: single fixture change (register_with!(%{}) then Repo.update_all seeding {{variables.absent}} with comment). No router, dispatcher, engine change. Verification: MIX_ENV=test mix compile --warnings-as-errors clean; mix format --check-formatted ok on touched files; scratch script (outside repo, not committed) confirmed all 21 REJECT and 11 ACCEPT URL classes from the design matrix via Entry.check_endpoint_url/1. Scoped tests (engine_catalog_service_task, service_catalog, url_validator, admin_services, admin_services_publish_retire, service_catalog_resolve_pinned_version, webhooks): 'Result: 141/147 passed'. The 6 failures are all in service_catalog_test.exs AC6 delete/1 and AC7 update_scope/2 referential-guard tests, failing with Postgrex 42P01 relation tenant_template_build_<hex>.process_definitions does not exist -- stale tenant_template_build_* tenant_schemas rows in the shared test DB (TenantSchemaReaper warnings list them); those paths never touch endpoint_url validation, so judged environmental, not caused by this change. The new regression matrix and U-NODNS tests are NOT written (TEST-DESIGNER). Docs item 4 (security-invariants.md INV-9 paragraph) not done; left for DOC-UPDATER. Not committed. Design-vs-code note: engine_catalog_service_task_test passed including the reseeded url_rendered_empty test.
